annotations.title: EPA facility compliance near a location

description: EPA facility compliance near a location — EPA-regulated facilities and their compliance record for a US ZIP code or a point (lat=&lon= with radius= miles up to 5, or place=): significant violators, facilities in violation now, toxic-release (TRI) reporters, formal enforcement actions, penalties, counts by program (air, water, hazardous waste) and a ranked list of facilities of concern with ECHO report links. Level CLEAN, MINOR, NOTABLE, SIGNIFICANT. Param: zip= (or lat/lon). Source: US EPA ECHO. Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: realestate_epa_facilities
